mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.change_group_id, h.event_type, h.field_name, h.old_value, h.new_value, h.related_record_id, h.actor_id, u.display_name AS actor_name, h.created_at FROM issue_histories h JOIN users u ON u.id = h.actor_id WHERE h.issue_id = #{issueId} AND h.event_type != 'comment_added' ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, h.id DESC
